representation.fontProvenance: The existing atlas requests installed system fonts; no binary is bundled. Native capture inventories installed fonts but exact fallback choice is not instrumented.

anchors: small round body with inflation silhouette
two raised eyes and a puckered mouth
paired paddle fins and short rear fan tail

parts.name: body
parts.motion: Smooth staged ellipsoid inflation, independent continuous buoyant bob and roll

parts.name: eyes
parts.motion: Follow the growing surface with two raised shells and dark pupils

parts.name: fins
parts.motion: Two attached rounded paddles with independent continuous phases

parts.name: tail
parts.motion: Attached short stalk and fan; naturally occluded front-on

parts.name: spines
parts.motion: 42 fixed radial attachments; bounded smooth length change, no spawning

phases.name: idle
phases.transition: Wait for sustained nearby normalized input

phases.name: belly
phases.transition: First inflation to55percent; retreat starts recovery

phases.name: spines
phases.transition: Complete inflation and short spine extension

phases.name: holding
phases.transition: Maximum buoyant hold; earlier retreat starts recovery

phases.name: recovering
phases.transition: Smooth deflation from captured current size

phases.name: cooldown
phases.transition: Cannot retrigger; retreat required to rearm after minimum rest

motion.replayGuarantee: Same version, config, seed and ordered exact tick event log reproduce state and actual legacy logical cells in tested runtime for1/2/5tick render groups. No cross-font pixel promise; arbitrary snapshot restore unsupported.

interaction.pointer: Current CSS rect normalized to[-1,1], aspect correction, no DPR in proximity; max one coalesced pointer input. Invalid/zero rectangles reject.
interaction.keyboard: Native Approach/Give space/Pause/Reset buttons; Enter/Space/Tab; no global shortcut.
interaction.touch: Native buttons with no hover dependence; pointer touch movement ignored. Physical touch execution unrun.
interaction.precedence: Retreat wins within a batch. Pause/reduced/compact gives deliberate static posters. Hidden/offscreen/zero size blocks actions. Configure resets species run but preserves pause.

accessibility.description: A small round pufferfish with two bright eyes, paddle fins and short radial spines when inflated.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Starts static, live preference changes cancel RAF. Pointer cannot override. Deliberate static inflated/calm poses remain available.
accessibility.pause: Independent user pause composes with reduced motion, hidden/offscreen/zero-sized/compact/destroyed. Reset/configure preserve pause.
accessibility.liveRegion: Only meaningful user action announcements. Glyphs and frame counters are not live.
